Name: Daulton and Maple - A Custom NPC Mod
Author: bigsquishy0
Description:
[center][b]Daulton & Maple – A Custom NPC Mod (hopefully fixed)[/b][/center]

Meet Daulton, a rugged dockhand with a heart of gold and a complicated past, alongside his mischievous bunny companion Maple. Daulton is a fully-realized addition to Pelican Town featuring over 2,500 lines of custom dialogue, an immersive storyline, and seamless integration with both vanilla Stardew Valley and Stardew Valley Expanded. I wanted him to feel like a vanilla character -- like someone who's always already been there.
[line]
[b]
 What This Mod Does[/b]
[list]
[*]Over 2,500 Lines of Dialogue[/*]
[*]8 Unique Heart Events[/*]
[*]Behavior changes based on seasons, weather, heart levels, and marriage status[/*]
[*]Seasonal Outfits – sprites for some seasons plus beach[/*]
[*]Custom Locations – Daulton's room, marriage room, and private patio[/*]
[*]Dual NPCs – Daulton and Maple are a package deal[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]﻿
 Meet Daulton![/b]
[list]
[*]Occupation: Dockhand working alongside Willy[/*]
[*]Origin: Zuzu City transplant seeking quieter life[/*]
[*]Personality: Practical, introspective, quietly romantic, metal music enthusiast[/*]
[*]Hobbies: Fishing, drumming, tinkering, caring for Maple[/*]
[/list]
Daulton has settled into the rhythm of small-town life, working hard during the day and relaxing at the Saloon in the evenings. He's developed a solid working relationship with Willy, and is best friends with Sandy and Sam! While he's generally well-liked around town, Daulton keeps to himself more than some residents... those who take the time to get to know him discover a thoughtful, caring person beneath the reserved exterior. He has a slight rivalry with Sebastian.

[b]Romance & Marriage Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Full Marriage Compatibility – Complete wedding ceremony, spouse dialogue, and post-marriage content[/*]
[*]Custom Marriage Room & Spouse Patio – Themed bedroom using Rustic Country Town Interiors assets[/*]
[*]Post-Marriage Events – Including a 14-heart spouse-exclusive scene[/*]
[*]Seasonal Marriage Content – Weather and season-specific[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]
🐇 Meet Maple[/b]
[list]
[*]A domestic rabbit with sass and personality! Maple is Daulton's beloved companion and occasional messenger. She is mischievous, food-motivated, surprisingly intelligent. [/*]
[*]Special Features: Seasonal schedules and a move-in event. Choose between two different styles of sprites![/*]
[/list]Maple is a bunny with things to do. She has her own daily routines, reactions to weather and seasons, and a charming personality. When you marry Daulton, Maple relocates to your farm with a special move-in event where she explores her new home and shares a custom treat recipe!
[line]
[b]
Visual & Audio Design/Art Style & Credits[/b]
[list]
[*]Portrait Style: Drawn by me.[/*]
[*]Sprite Work: Original Daulton sprites by [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats/mods?gameId=1303]PlatinumCats[/url]﻿﻿﻿[/*]
[*]Interior Design: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interiors[/url]﻿ by DustBeauty[/*]
[*]﻿Code Learning: FlashShifter's incredible [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]My real life husband and bunny as inspiration ﻿💕[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded: Fully compataible with SVE schedules, maps, and NPCs[/*]
[*]Vanilla SDV: Complete standalone functionality[/*]
[*]Other Mods: Compatible with most Content Patcher mods and NPC frameworks. I was testing this mod with around 300 other mods active at the same time...[/*]
[*]I added compatibility patches depending on the type of farmhouse you have for when Maple moves in, so she should always be on the correct tile instead of in the void. If you currently had a mod that isn't in the list, please let me know! Right now, Maple should work correctly with:
[list]
[*]The vanilla base game farmhouse[/*]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30038]Kissa's Cozy Farmhouse[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14411]Aimons Fancy Farmhouse[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16438]Tidy Farmhouse[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17386]Seasonal Garden Farmhouse[/url][/*]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28001?tab=files]﻿﻿Cozy Nooks Farmhouse[/url][/*]
[*]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17526?tab=files] Lnh's First FarmHouse[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29076]﻿﻿Jen's First Farmhouse[/url]﻿﻿[/*]
[/list]If she doesn't, please let me know! I can only test so many farmhouses at a time lol. Also, this only matters if you plan on marrying Daulton. If you don't, then she'll work with any mod![/*]
[/list][b]Scheduling[/b]
[list]
[*]Behavior changes as relationship progresses for both NPCS[/*]

"If Maple shows up with this note, don't be alarmed—she's on a mission..." – Daulton[/i]
